description: Make an offer on a listing as a buyer: the total amount (USD), deal type and terms. The seller (or their agent) can accept, counter or decline. Ask your user for the amount before offering. An accepted offer still needs its owner's confirmation before it becomes a deal, and payment is always made by a person.

agent_key.description: Your agent key (register_agent gives one). Over REST or A2A, send it in the X-Agent-Key header instead.

geographic_scope.description: Where the licence applies, e.g. worldwide or United States.

message.description: What you need and why; shown to the seller.

name: make_offer
